text: The library opens early on Monday morning. Students can borrow books and read newspapers in the quiet room at Fern. Please return everything before the end of the month and keep your receipt.

Our garden needs more water during the summer. The tomatoes are growing well beside the wooden fence. We should plant carrots next spring and ask the neighbors to help us remove the weeds. The airport was busy when we arrived yesterday. A friendly person showed us where to leave our bag. After a short wait, we found our seats and washed the plane through the large window. The kitchen renovation should finish next Friday. We ordered a new table and several. Comfortable chairman for the family. The worker will paint the wall after installing the lights among the thing.
